facility.name: The Childrens Courtyard
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Accredited,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1865 WIMBLEDON DR, ARLINGTON, TX, 76017

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two children's records lacked complete information for the child's physician or an emergency care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Complete personnel and training files were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Four children's records lacked the address for the listed emergency contact person.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Five children's records did not contain a health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: The presence of ants on the toddler playground was not communicated with the caregiver resulting in a child getting multiple ant bites that caused an allergic reaction.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Transportation safety training was not available for review for the listed drivers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infants did not have updated feeding instructions on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: One child did not have a food allergy plan on file at the center.  One child's food allergy plan was not signed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors: Safety documentation for emergency drills, fire extinguishers, and carbon monoxide & smoke detectors was not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Documentation for Emergency Drills, Fire Extinguishers, & Smoke Detectors (26 TAC §746.801(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Staff training records were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: There was no one designated to be in charge of the operation during the director's absence.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director is not ensuring the operation is operating in compliance with minimum standards.  The director did not ensure proper coverage during her absence which also resulted in a group being out of compliance with ratio.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: It was determined that the operation was out of compliance with child/caregiver ratios.  There were 17 children ages 3 - 7 years with one caregiver.  The specified age for the group was 3 years which only allows for 15 children.  The group was over ratio by 2 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: A caregiver provided the ages of the children in her group which were later found to be incorrect.  The caregiver reported that the children in her group were all 2 years but the children ranged in age from 16 months - 2 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: It was found that on at least one occasion, a 5-month-old infant and a 16-month-old infant were combined with children that exceeded the 18-month age difference allowed between the oldest and youngest child in the group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: It was determined that the lists used for before and after school transportation were not accurate.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was determined that the operation's driver dropped a child off at the wrong elementary school during before school transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the information obtained during the investigation, a lack of supervision was determined. A child got out of the playground and wandered off of the operation's property. The child was returned to the operation by an unknown bystander.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: At the time of inspection, complete personnel and training documentation was not available for 2 staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: The floors in the schoolage room, kitchen, and preschool restroom were not clean - along with 2 sinks in the schoolage room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Documentation of emergency drills and checks was not available at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Several slats were missing from the wooden railing of the deck on the outdoor playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: Complete personnel and training files were not available at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: The director and 3 drivers did not have documentation of current transportation safety training available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have a current fire inspection on file.  The last fire inspection was completed 11/2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A build up of dirt and grime was observed on the flooring in the restrooms of several  of the classrooms.      One of the rugs in the preschool room had curled edges and posed as a tripping hazard.       There was a hole observed along the bottom of the wall in the pre-kindergarten restroom.  There were 4 electrical outlets that did not have childproof covers and one of the outlet covers was cracked/broken and needed to be replaced.  (Note: The broken outlet was replaced during the inspection.  Childproof covers were added to the 4 oulets).    There were areas on the walls in the school age classroom that were visibly dirty.  There was a section of the baseboard that had become detached from the wall.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient when a caregiver regularly grabbed children by the arm as a form of redirection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient when caregiver pushed a child in the face as a form of punishment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: It was determined that a child was left unattended in the classroom during the morning bus run. The child had fallen asleep and was left behind in the room. Staff did not catch this during the face to name/roll checks out of the classroom and onto the bus.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: This standard was reviewed and found to be deficient when children were allowed to run and "horseplay" in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Two areas of the outside wall of the building (facing the playground), ave become weathered - causing significant paint chipping & the potential for splintering. (Photos taken)
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The feeding instructions for 3 infant children have not been updated within the past 30 days. (The infants are not yet on table food).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: It was determined that due to not accurately completing the face-to-name roll sheet, a caregiver left a child outside & unsupervised for one hour & twenty-eight minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on information obtained during the investigation, neglectful supervision by a caregiver was determined.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
